description: Fork only (see FORK.md): enforce the feature loop when the repo (or its main worktree) has .scratch/gates.json without status closed. PreToolUse on Bash, PowerShell and MCP tools (matcher anchored) gates git commit (slop in the staged lines), git push and PR creation (build-phase gates; pushes to the base branch refused) and gh pr merge or a GraphQL mergePullRequest (match-head-commit, merge-phase gates, green CI on that sha, HEAD equal to that sha); a PowerShell call that ships is refused and sent to Bash, and the MCP tools create_pull_request, merge_pull_request, push_files, create_or_update_file, delete_file and update_pull_request_branch are gated like their gh and git equivalents; fails closed while a loop is active. Stop refuses to end a turn while a stage is running. SessionStart summarizes where the loop stands.
